Makkah, Madinah, Jeddah and Taif

School started on Sunday 30 August 2026 and ends on Thursday 1 July 2027, a week after the other regions, with one extra day off (25 October) and an earlier Eid al-Adha break from 23 Dhu al-Qa'dah.

Frequently asked questions

When is the autumn break in 1448?

From Friday 20 November 2026 after school on Thursday 19 November, plus an extra day off on Sunday 29 November in most regions, so students return on Monday 30 November (10 days). In Makkah, Madinah, Jeddah and Taif they return on Sunday 29 November.

When does the 1448 school year end?

The last school day is Thursday 24 June 2027 (19 Muharram 1449), and Thursday 1 July 2027 in Makkah, Madinah, Jeddah and Taif.
